_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Saying th like z or s, w like v, and stressing the wrong syllable

items.gloss_en: Put your tongue between your teeth, not z.
Put your tongue between your teeth, not s.
Round your lips, it is not v.
The stress is on the second syllable.

segments.text: Four words many learners say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.caption: Говорите «зис» вместо “this” и «синк» вместо “think”? Следите за th, за звуком w в слове “water” и за ударением в слове “hotel”. Послушайте Аму, а в паузе повторите. Практика произношения в приложении Lexkite.

en.caption: Do you say “zis” instead of “this” and “sink” instead of “think”? Watch the th, the w sound in “water” and the stress in “hotel”. Listen to Ama, then repeat in the pause. Pronunciation practice is in the Lexkite app.
